prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Do you understand and agree to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Great. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through Baytown, Texas, and I was turning left at an intersection with a traffic light. The light was green for my direction, or at least I thought it was. I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.

Q: How fast were you going when you started the turn?

A: I was basically stopped, maybe rolling a little. I'd say under ten miles per hour.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car coming straight through from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my vehicle. I didn't see it until it was right on me. I think they were coming through on a yellow or just after it turned red, but I can't say for sure.

Q: Did you or the other driver brake before impact?

A: I tried to stop, but there wasn't time. The impact threw me forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Are you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and upper back are really sore. I have stiffness and headaches, and turning my head to the left hurts a lot. I went to urgent care that same afternoon and they diagnosed whiplash.

Q: Have you seen any other providers since then?

A: I'm scheduled for physical therapy twice a week, and my doctor has me on muscle relaxers for now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this resolved so I can get back to normal.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
